title: Channels
summary: A channel is a trend whose swings have stayed between two roughly parallel sloping lines.
unreliableWhen: The lines depend on which swing points you pick, and are easy to redraw to fit. Price can overshoot or fall short of a line, and the slope can change.
goodExample: Joining two swing highs in a downtrend, drawing a parallel line through the low between them, and writing a rule for what counts as a break.
badExample: Redrawing the channel after every candle so price always "respects" it.

chart.lookFor: Use the Trend line tool to join two swing highs, then draw a parallel line through the lowest low between them. Count the closes outside your lines.
